name: Mall Floor Tile Module
summary: A 1.2 m square repeat module with four honed ivory terrazzo slabs and continuous 4 mm warm-grey grout joints.
description: A 1.2 m square repeat module with four honed ivory terrazzo slabs and continuous 4 mm warm-grey grout joints.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry, Principled materials and seeded Pillow terrazzo artwork. No third-party assets or downloaded pixels.

assembly.instructions: Instance whole root at 1.2 m increments in glTF X/Z, height Y=0. Quarter-turn Y rotations preserve joints. Each module carries 2 mm of the boundary joint; never add a second grout border. Do not scale modules for mixed dimensions.

material_notes: Original 512 x 512 embedded PNG, seed 421, four UV orientations. Five independently editable mesh objects: four eased stone slabs and a continuous grout bed. Separate body, finish and grout materials; source texture is packed. Filled grout is 1 mm below the wearing surface. The grout bed is a closed mesh with slab recesses, not an overlapping full-height box.
accuracy_notes: Generic decorative mall flooring concept. No slip resistance, fire rating, accessibility, fabrication or Singapore/Malaysia building-code certification is claimed.

attribution.credit: Original geometry, materials and seeded terrazzo artwork authored for Blender-3D-Gallery; no external artwork.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

quality_gate.scope: Local artifact; desktop browser evidence is recorded in verification.md. Actual Android and iOS browsers have not been tested.
